body:
Some of our favorite days to photograph are the small ones — an intimate micro wedding right here in Plant City, with just the people who matter most.

This couple kept things simple and close to home: soft white details, a few loved ones nearby, and a lot of quiet, in-between moments. Without a giant timeline to race through, we had room to slow down and catch the real things — the look before the vows, the held breath, the easy laughter afterward.

## Why couples are choosing micro weddings

A micro wedding is exactly what it sounds like — a full wedding scaled down to its most meaningful parts. Fewer guests, less stress, and more of your budget left for the things you actually care about. For us as photographers it means more time with you, and more of the genuine, unhurried moments that make the best images.

## A Plant City team that feels like family

We are a family-owned team of four sisters based right here in Plant City, serving all of Tampa Bay and Central Florida. We photograph weddings the way we'd want our own remembered — warmly, honestly, and without stiff posing. If you are looking for a Plant City wedding photographer who will treat your small day like the big deal it is, that is exactly what we love to do.

## Thinking about an intimate wedding of your own?

Whether it is a backyard, a courthouse, a favorite Plant City spot, or somewhere out in Tampa Bay, we would love to help you plan it. Take a look through our [portfolio](/portfolio), explore our [services and packages](/services), and then [get in touch](/contact) to check availability for your date.
